request.style: English, solo male baritone with gospel choir, acoustic guitar, piano, organ, cello, warm and reverent, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The line of David stands
Through Hananiah and Rephaiah
Obadiah and Shecaniah
Names recorded in the book

[Chorus]
Hattush Igal Bariah
Neariah and Shaphat too
Six sons of Shemaiah
Counted in the ancient scroll

[Verse]
After the exile deep
The royal line was kept alive
Shemaiah had six sons
Their names were written down

[Chorus]
Hattush Igal Bariah
Neariah and Shaphat too
Six sons of Shemaiah
Counted in the ancient scroll

[Bridge]
From Shecaniah to Shemaiah
The bloodline holds its ground
Preserved through the years of waiting
In the land and far away

[Outro]
Hattush Igal Bariah
Neariah Shaphat six
